title: Mozzarella, Avocado & Sun-Dried Tomato Tortilla Wrap

steps.text: Place tortillas on a flat surface. Spread each tortilla with mayo.
Thinly slice cheese and layer over the tortilla.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Layer over the cheese.
Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes. Place on top of the avocado.
Tightly roll tortillas around the filling and secure with toothpicks (optional).
To serve, divide wraps between plates and enjoy!
